context: M2 o4. Room 1112. Hollis in his undershirt, a radio on his knee, the window jammed shut.

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: Shipmate! Close the door, you're letting the heat in. Ha.

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: Fan's broke. Window's stuck. Otherwise it's a palace.

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: Odessa says somebody bought the boat. That right?

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: Somebody bought it. I don't know who's steering.

lines.speaker: char.walter_hollis
lines.text: Forty years at sea and I die in a hotel? Not this hotel, shipmate.

lines.speaker: char.teddy_arce
lines.text: I'll bring a fan up from the basement. Gus owes me.
